blocks.text: The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.

The negative imperative is, as a rule, in the imperfective aspect: *Берите! Возьмите! — Не берите!* The negative imperative in the perfective aspect is relatively rare and has the meaning of a strict warning against acts which might lead to detrimental results: *Смотрите, не забудьте, что сегодня у нас важное собрание. Здесь скользко, не упадите!*
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 42, 84.
Further sentences, so that every pattern above is practised: from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English.

exercises.q: ___ (сложить) этот листок пополам вертикально, потом горизонтально.
exercises.prompt: Fold this sheet in half vertically and horizontally.
Don't ever talk to me again.
exercises.why: **заговаривать → заговаривай** — imperative, singular (to «ты»): ending -й (stem ends in a vowel).

exercises.prompt: Don't go beyond the speed limit.
exercises.why: **превышать → превышай** — imperative, singular (to «ты»): ending -й (stem ends in a vowel).

exercises.q: ___ (задуть) все свечи на своём именинном пироге одним махом.
exercises.prompt: Blow out all the candles on the birthday cake at once.
exercises.why: **задуть → Задуй** — imperative, singular (to «ты»): ending -й (stem ends in a vowel).
**терять → теряй** — imperative, singular (to «ты»): ending -й (stem ends in a vowel).

exercises.q: ___ (дать) молоку постоять ночь, а потом снимите с него сливки.
exercises.prompt: Let the milk stand overnight and skim off the cream.
exercises.why: **дать → Дайте** — imperative, polite / plural: the singular дай + -те.

exercises.prompt: Don't play with the mud. You're getting dirty.
exercises.why: **играть → играй** — imperative, singular (to «ты»): ending -й (stem ends in a vowel).
**утруждать → утруждай** — imperative, singular (to «ты»): ending -й (stem ends in a vowel).
